caption:
Gartner projects that by the end of 2026, 20% of organisations will cut more than half their middle management. That window is the next three months.

Look at what the layer actually does. Chasing status updates. Consolidating reports. Moving information from one meeting to the next. AI absorbs all of it, cheaply and without complaint.

What it does not absorb: judgement under pressure. Bearing when the room turns. The authority to hold a decision while six people push back.

So 'competent and busy' is now the most automatable version of a manager. If your value is coordination, you have priced yourself as software.

In command, the officer who only relayed orders was replaceable. The one who could stand in front of the room and be believed was not. Same rule, different building.

Stop optimising your throughput. Start building your presence.

topic.title: AI flattening is deleting middle management coordination work
topic.angle: For the mid-to-senior Indian manager, if AI absorbs coordination, reporting and status updates, what remains as your value is precisely judgement, command presence and the ability to hold a room — making 'competent and busy' the most automatable version of a manager.
topic.why_now: Indian restructuring coverage from 5 September 2026 is nine days old and the cited Gartner projection — 20% of organisations cutting over half of middle management — has an end-of-2026 window, meaning the next three months.

rationale: A stark text-only visual matches the caption's blunt thesis and keeps attention on the single line that reframes the reader's own job description.
